text:
ashley: FYI CI flagged a microbench regression on my PR — tail latency up ~7% for the tiny-batch / seq=1 path. Blocking merge until we understand.
ci-bot: PR #17650 benchmark: seq1_tail_latency_ms
```
baseline: 1.12 ms
pr:       1.20 ms
diff:     +0.08 ms (+7.14%)
threshold: +3.0% allowed
``` 
ben: ugh. 7% is above the perf gate. I saw something similar locally — kernel selection switched from fast_fused to fallback_scalar for very small batches.
zara: logs show autopath decision score flipped after the optimizer rewrite in the recent merge: kernel_selector_score 0.62 -> 0.28 around model init.
prashant: I ran the microbench with AUTOPATH_DEBUG=1 and captured the selector trace:
```
AUTOPATH: evaluate candidates [fast_fused, fast_matmul, fallback_scalar]
scores: {fast_fused: 0.31, fast_matmul: 0.37, fallback_scalar: 0.32}
selected: fast_matmul
note: previously selected fast_fused on same input
```
ashley: that matches — selector now prefers a different kernel for short sequences which increases per-token overhead for seq=1.
ben: could this be due to the threshold normalization change in optimizer/score_norm? The PR touched that file.
zara: yes, the normalization reduces spike bias; it's intended, but it regresses the tiny-batch hotpath.
prashant: quick mitigation I tested: force kernel preference back with env var REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREF=fast_fused; local microbench returns to baseline.
ashley: can we do a hotfix: pin kernel preference for seq <= 2 until we ship a proper selector tweak? That would unblock the rollout.
ben: alternative: adjust score_norm constant from 0.001 -> 0.0001 (narrower change) — small delta but might keep the old ordering.
zara: both viable. Which is safer for rollout? Pinning is narrower but adds special-case; adjusting constant touches the heuristic more generally.
ashley: ops: this is blocking the merge. I'd prefer pin + follow-up refactor. I'll open a revert/patch.
ci-bot: scheduled re-run of microbench on ephemeral pool (job id: bench-ephemeral-9217)
ci-bot: bench-ephemeral-9217: FAILED (same diff)
prashant: reran with pinned pref in a branch (patch attached) — microbench passes locally, I'll push to CI in a sec.
ben: please also add an invariant test that freezes kernel selection for seq <= 2 so future optimizer tweaks don't silently flip this hotpath.
zara: agreed — a small perf unit that asserts selected kernel for a canonical seq=1 prompt.
ashley: created PERF-1234, added pin patch to PR and a unit test. Leaving the rollout blocked until CI stabilizes.
ci-bot: PR #17650 (with pin patch) microbench re-run: PASS (diff +0.9%) — within threshold ✅
ben: nice. We should still follow up: refactor autopath scoring so it considers latency per-request overhead, not just bulk throughput.
zara: logging notes, I'll add telemetry to track selector flips in prod for the next week.
ashley: fyi i'll merge the pin patch as a hotfix branch and file the long-term follow-up in the optimizer epic. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
